translation: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai
Ya-Seen !
hikmat bharay Quran ki qasam !
tum yaqeenan payghumberon mein say ho
bilkul seedhay raastay per !
yeh Quran uss zaat ki taraf say utaara jaraha hai jiss ka iqtidar bhi kamil hai , jiss ki rehmat bhi kamil ,
takay tum unn logon  ko khabrdar kero jinn kay baap dadon ko pehlay khabrdar nahi kiya gaya tha ,   iss liye woh ghaflat mein parray huye hain .
haqeeqat yeh hai kay unn mein say aksar logon  kay baaray mein baat poori hochuki hai ,   iss liye woh emaan nahi latay .
hum ney unn kay galon mein toq daal rakhay hain , jo thorriyon tak phonchay huye hain , aur iss wajeh say unn kay sar oopper ko uthay reh gaye hain .

aur hum ney aik aarr unn kay aagay kharri kerdi hai , aur aik aarr unn kay peechay kharri kerdi hai , aur iss tarah unhen her taraf say dhaank liya hai jiss kay nateejay mein unhen kuch sujhai nahi deta .
aur unn kay liye dono baaten barabar hain , chahye tum unhen khabrdar kero , ya khabrdar naa kero , woh emaan nahi layen gay .

tum to sirf aesay shaks ko khabrdar ker-saktay ho jo naseehat per chalay , aur khudaye rehman ko dekhay baghair uss say daray . chunacheh aesay shaks ko tum maghfirat aur ba-izzat ajar ki khushkhabri suna do .

yaqeenan hum hi murdon ko zinda keren gay , aur jo kuch amal unhon ney aagay bhejay hain , hum unn ko bhi likhtay jatay hain , aur unn kay kamon kay jo asraat hain unn ko bhi .   aur hum ney aik wazeh kitab mein her her cheez ka poora ehata ker rakha hai .
aur ( aey payghumber ! ) tum inn kay samney aik basti walon ki misal paish kero , jab unn kay paas Rasool aaye thay .

jab hum ney unn kay paas ( shuroo mein ) do Rasool bhejay , to unhon ney dono ko jhutla diya , phir hum ney aik teesray kay zariye unn ki taeed ki , aur unn sabb ney kaha kay :  yaqeen jano hamen tumharay paas Rasool bana ker bheja gaya hai .
unhon ney kaha :  tumhari haqeeqat iss kay siwa kuch bhi nahi kay tum hum jaisay hi aadmi ho . aur khudaye rehman ney koi cheez nazil nahi ki hai , aur tum sarasar jhoot bol rahey ho .
unn ( Rasoolon ) ney kaha :  humara perwerdigar khoob janta hai kay hamen waqaee tumharay paas Rasool bana ker bheja gaya hai .
aur humari zimma daari iss say ziyada nahi hai kay saaf saaf paygham phoncha den .

basti walon ney kaha :  hum ney to tumharay andar nahoosat mehsoos ki hai .   yaqeen jano agar tum baaz naa aaye to hum tum per pathar barsayen gay , aur humaray haathon tumhen bari dardnak saza milay gi .

Rasoolon ney kaha :  tumhari nahoosat khud tumharay sath lagi hoi hai .   kiya yeh baaten iss liye ker rahey ho kay tumhen naseehat ki baat phonchai gaee hai ? asal baat yeh hai kay tum khud hadd say guzray huye log ho .
aur shehar kay perlay ilaqay say aik shaks dorrta huwa aaya .   uss ney kaha :  aey meri qoam kay logo ! inn Rasoolon ka kehna maan lo ,
inn logon  ka kehna maan lo jo tum say koi ujrat nahi maang rahey , aur woh sahih raastay per hain .
aur bhala mein uss zaat ki ibadat kiyon naa kerun jiss ney mujhay peda kiya hai ? aur ussi ki taraf tum sabb ko wapis bheja jaye ga .

bhala kiya ussay chorr ker mein aeson ko mabood maanun kay agar khudaye rehman mujhay koi nuqsan phonchaney ka irada kerlay to unn ki sifarish meray kissi kaam naa aaye , aur naa woh mujhay churra saken-?
agar mein aisa kerun ga to yaqeenan mein khuli gumrahi mein mubtala hojaon ga .
mein to tumharay perwerdigar per emaan laa-chuka . abb tum bhi meri baat sunn lo .

. ( aakhir kaar basti walon ney uss ko qatal kerdiya ,   aur Allah taalaa ki taraf say uss say ) kaha gaya kay :  jannat mein dakhil hojao .    uss ney ( jannat ki naimaten dekh ker ) kaha kay :  kaash ! meri qoam ko maloom hojaye
kay meray perwerdigar ney kiss tarah meri bakhshish ki hai , aur mujhay ba-izzat logon  mein shamil kiya hai !
aur uss shaks kay baad hum ney uss ki qoam per aasman say koi lashkar nahi utaara , aur naa hamen utaarney ki zaroorat thi .
woh to bus aik hi chinghaarr thi jiss say woh aik dum bujh ker reh gaye .
afsos hai aesay bandon kay haal per ! unn kay paas koi Rasool aisa nahi aaya jiss ka woh mazaq naa uratay rahey hon .
kiya unhon ney nahi dekha kay unn say pehlay hum kitni qoamon ko iss tarah halak ker-chukay hain kay woh unn kay paas loat ker nahi aatay ?
aur yeh jitney log hain , inn sabhi ko ikattha ker kay humaray samney hazir kiya jaye ga .
aur inn kay liye aik nishani woh zameen hai jo murda parri hoi thi . hum ney ussay zindagi ata ki , aur uss say ghalla nikala , jiss ki khurak yeh khatay hain .
aur hum ney uss zameen mein khajooron aur angooron kay baagh peda kiye , aur aisa intizam kiya kay uss mein say paani kay chashmay phoot niklay ,
takay yeh uss ki pedawaar mein say khayen , halankay uss ko inn kay haathon ney nahi banaya tha .   kiya phir bhi yeh shukar ada nahi keren gay ?

pak hai woh zaat jiss ney her cheez kay jooray jooray peda kiye hain , uss pedawaar kay bhi jo zameen ugati hai , aur khud inn insanon kay bhi , aur unn cheezon kay bhi jinhen yeh log ( abhi ) jantay tak nahi hain .
aur inn kay liye aik aur nishani raat hai . hum uss per say din ka chilka utaar letay hain to woh yakayak andheray mein reh jatay hain .
aur sooraj apney thikaney ki taraf chala jaraha hai . yeh sabb uss zaat ka muqarrar kiya huwa nizam hai jiss ka iqtidar bhi kamil hai , jiss ka ilm bhi kamil .

aur chaand hai kay hum ney uss ki manzilen naap tol ker muqarrar kerdi hain , yahan tak kay woh jab ( unn manzilon kay doray say ) loat ker aata hai to khajoor ki purani tehni ki tarah ( patla ) ho ker reh jata hai .
naa to sooraj ki yeh majal hai kay woh chaand ko ja-pakray ,   aur naa raat din say aagay nikal sakti hai . aur yeh sabb apney apney madaar mein ter rahey hain .
aur inn kay liye aik aur nishani yeh hai kay hum ney inn ki aulad ko bhari hoi kashti mein sawar kiya ,
aur hum ney inn kay liye ussi jaisi aur cheezen bhi peda ken jinn per yeh sawari kertay hain .
aur agar hum chahen to enhen gharq ker daalen , jiss kay baad naa to koi inn ki fariyad ko phonchay , aur naa unn ki jaan bachai jasakay .
lekin yeh sabb humari taraf say aik rehmat hai , aur aik moyyan waqt tak ( zindagi ka ) maza uthaney ka moaqa hai ( jo enhen diya jaraha hai ) .
aur jab inn say kaha jata hai kay :  bacho uss ( azab ) say jo tumharay samney hai , aur jo tumharay ( marney kay ) baad aaye ga , takay tum per reham kiya jaye .  ( to woh zara kaan nahi dhartay )
aur unn kay perwerdigar ki nishaniyon mein say koi nishani aesi nahi aati jiss say woh mun naa morr letay hon .

aur jab unn say kaha jata hai kay :  Allah ney tumhen jo rizq diya hai , uss mein say ( ghareebon per bhi ) kharch kero  , to yeh kafir log musalmanon say kehtay hain kay :  kiya hum unn logon  ko khana khilayen jinhen agar Allah chahta to khud khila deta ? ( musalmano ! ) tumhari haqeeqat iss kay siwa kuch bhi nahi kay tum khuli gumrahi mein parray huye ho .
aur kehtay hain kay :  yeh ( qayamat ka ) wada kab poora hoga-? ( musalmano ! ) batao , agar tum sachay ho .
. ( darasal ) yeh log bus aik chinghaarr ka intizar ker rahey hain jo inn ki hujjat bazi kay aen darmiyan enhen aa-pakray gi ,
phir naa yeh koi wasiyyat ker-saken gay , aur naa apney ghar walon kay paas loat ker jasaken gay .
aur soor phoonka jaye ga to yakayak yeh apni qabron say nikal ker apney perwerdigar ki taraf tezi say rawana hojayen gay .

kahen gay kay :  haaye humari kam bakhti ! hamen kiss ney humaray marqad say utha kharra kiya hai ?  ( jawab milay ga kay ) :  yeh wohi cheez hai jiss ka khudaye rehman ney wada kiya tha , aur payghumberon ney sachi baat kahi thi .
aur kuch nahi , bus aik zor ki aawaz hogi , jiss kay baad yeh sabb kay sabb humaray samney hazir kerdiye jayen gay .
chunacheh uss din kissi shaks per koi zulm nahi hoga , aur tumhen kissi aur cheez ka nahi , balkay unhi kamon ka badla milay ga jo tum kiya kertay thay .
jannat walay log uss din yaqeenan apney mashghalay mein magan hon gay ,
woh aur unn ki biwiyan ghaney sayon mein aaram deh nishiston per tek lagaye huye hon gay .
wahan unn kay liye meway hon gay , aur unhen her woh cheez milay gi jo woh mangwayen gay .
rehmat walay perwerdigar ki taraf say unhen salam kaha jaye ga .
. ( aur kafiron say kaha jaye ga kay : )  aey mujrimo ! aaj tum ( mominon say ) alag hojao .
aey Adam kay beto ! kiya mein ney tumhen yeh takeed nahi kerdi thi kay tum shetan ki ibadat naa kerna , woh tumhara khula dushman hai ,
aur yeh kay tum meri ibadat kerna . yehi seedha raasta hai .
aur haqeeqat yeh hai kay shetan ney tum mein say aik bari khilqat ko gumrah ker daala . to kiya tum samajhtay nahi thay ?
yeh hai woh jahannum jiss say tumhen daraya jata tha !
aaj iss mein dakhil hojao , kiyonkay tum kufr kiya kertay thay .
aaj kay din hum unn kay mun per mohar lagaden gay , aur unn kay haath hum say baat keren gay , aur unn kay paon gawahi den gay kay woh kiya kamai kiya kertay thay .
aur agar hum chahen to ( yahin duniya mein ) unn ki aankhen malya mait kerden , phir yeh raastay ( ki talash ) mein bhagay phiren , lekin enhen kahan kuch sujhai dey ga ?
aur agar hum chahen to inn ki apni jagah per bethay bethay inn ki soorten iss tarah maskh kerden kay yeh naa aagay barh saken , aur naa peechay loat saken .
aur hum jiss shaks ko lambi umar detay hain , ussay takhleeqi aetbar say ulat hi detay hain .   kiya phir bhi unhen aqal nahi aati-?

aur hum ney ( apney ) inn ( payghumber ) ko naa shaeeri sikhai hai , aur naa woh inn kay shayaan-e-shaan hai .   yeh to bus aik naseehat ki baat hai , aur aisa Quran jo haqeeqat ko khol khol ker biyan kerta hai ,
takay her uss shaks ko khabrdar keray jo zinda ho ,   aur takay kufr kernay walon per hujjat poori hojaye .
aur kiya unhon ney yeh nahi dekha kay hum ney apney haathon ki banai hoi cheezon mein say unn kay liye maweshi peda kiye , aur yeh unn kay malik banay huye hain-?
aur hum ney inn maweshiyon ko unn kay qaboo mein dey diya hai , chunacheh inn mein say kuch woh hain jo inn ki sawari banay huye hain , aur kuch woh hain jinhen yeh khatay hain .
neez inn ko inn maweshiyon say aur bhi fawaeed hasil hotay hain , aur peenay ki cheezen milti hain . kiya phir bhi yeh shukar nahi baja layen gay ?
aur enhon ney Allah ko chorr ker iss umeed per doosray khuda bana rakhay hain kay enhen ( unn say ) madad milay ,

. ( halankay ) unn mein yeh taqat hi nahi hai kay inn ki madad ker-saken , balkay woh inn kay liye aik aisa ( mukhalif ) lashkar banen gay jissay ( qayamat mein inn kay samney ) hazir kerliya jaye ga .
gharz ( aey payghumber ! ) inn ki baaten tumhen ranjeedah naa keren . yaqeen jano hamen sabb maloom hai kay yeh kiya kuch chupatay , aur kiya kuch zahir kertay hain .
aur kiya insan ney yeh nahi dekha kay hum ney ussay nutfay say peda kiya tha-? phir achanak woh khullam khula jhagrra kernay wala ban gaya .
humaray baaray mein to woh baaten banata hai , aur khud apni pedaeesh ko bhula betha hai . kehta hai kay :  inn haddiyon ko kon zindagi dey ga jabkay woh gal chuki hon gi ?
keh do kay :  inn ko wohi zindagi dey ga jiss ney enhen pehli baar peda kiya tha , aur woh peda kernay ka her kaam janta hai ,
wohi hai jiss ney tumharay liye sarsabz darkht say aag peda kerdi hai ,   phir tum zara si dair mein uss say sulganey ka kaam ley letay ho .

bhala jiss zaat ney aasmano aur zameen ko peda kiya hai , kiya woh iss baat per qadir nahi hai kay inn jaison ko ( dobara ) peda ker-sakay ? kiyon nahi-? jabkay woh sabb kuch peda kernay ki poori maharat rakhta hai !
uss ka moamla to yeh hai kay jab woh kissi cheez ka irada kerlay to sirf itna kehta hai kay :  hoja  bus woh hojati hai .
gharz pak hai woh zaat jiss kay haath mein her cheez ki hukoomat hai , aur ussi ki taraf tum sabb ko aakhir kaar ley jaya jaye ga .
